text: Pre-announcement leaks about a pending N/DPA, including leaks by prosecutors, should not move markets significantly because leaked details carry no certainty or finality as to final terms or fine amount.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy Lacine, Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements (2015). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2629451

isBasedOn.name: Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements

abstract: We assume that such leaks will not precipitate significant market movements as there is no certainty or finality as to the final terms of the NDPA and the amount of a fine.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: leaks of fine amounts or agreement form weeks or months before the announcement
